newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson rockets Swedish shares to record high.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson rockets Swedish shares to record high.

text.p: Swedish shares opened with gains after Wall Street firmed overnight but rose to a new all-time high on Thursday after Ericsson soared six percent.
The market's general index climbed 1.72 percent to 2,194.01 with shares worth 5.3 billion crowns traded.
The star performer of the day was telecoms company Ericsson which posted strong gains in the wake of a good nine month report by Finnish rival Nokia.
Ericsson shares worth 1.3 billion crowns changed hands and the stock closed 12 crowns higher at 205 crowns, its record close.

"This was mainly due to the strong report from Nokia," one broker told Reuters. "But interest in telecoms has been quite strong lately, particularly compared to other industrials, and Ericsson has good numbers and good growth."
Fellow bluechip drug major Astra rose four to 299.5 crowns.
Defence industries group Celsius posted a 36 percent rise in nine month profits and forecast full year 1996 profits at 275 million crowns. It closed one crown higher at 85 crowns.
